prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic 2:3 high-contrast black-and-white cinematic noir portrait of a stylish adult man in a well-tailored black suit, dark shirt, and polished black shoes, leaning confidently against the front quarter of a futuristic silver sports car. Pose him with one hand in a trouser pocket, relaxed legs, and a composed gaze toward camera. Set the scene on a snowy city street at night with tall buildings, distant bokeh lights, fresh snow, tire tracks, falling snowflakes, and a subtle atmospheric smoke plume.
